items.title: Banking watchdogs ramp up AI scrutiny as stability fears mount, sources say
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: The debate over AI oversight has intensified amid warnings from the industry after recent incidents.
items.body:
Banking watchdogs ramp up AI scrutiny as stability fears mount, sources say
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

Three top regulators in the United States, including the Federal Reserve, are quizzing banks about their use of advanced artificial intelligence models, two of the people told Reuters, which adds to prior scrutiny.
PHOTO: REUTERS

Published   Oct 13, 2026, 03:15 PM

Updated   Oct 13, 2026, 03:15 PM

Set as preferred source

Summarise

Banking regulators in the US and Europe are stepping up AI checks as fears grow that agentic AI could weaken cyber defences and threaten financial stability.
US agencies, including the Fed, OCC and FDIC, are asking banks how they use advanced AI, especially foreign models, cyber defence agents and controls on autonomous systems.
European supervisors want stronger recovery plans and better mapping of AI use across banks and providers, as experts warn a major attack could disrupt payments and lock customers out.

AI generated

NEW YORK/LONDON – Banking regulators are stepping up efforts to contain growing AI risks, six people familiar with the matter said, with some pointing to the potential for cyberattacks on banks or rogue agents undermining global financial stability .
The regulatory scrutiny, fresh details of which are reported here for the first time, reflects growing recognition that advances in frontier AI may require costly investments in cyber recovery, greater attention to dependencies on external technology providers and in some jurisdictions more formal regulatory guidance, sources said.
Three top regulators in the United States, including the Federal Reserve, are quizzing banks about their use of advanced artificial intelligence models, two of the people told Reuters, which adds to prior scrutiny.

Questions include whether they deploy Chinese-developed technology, use AI agents in cyber defence and can control increasingly autonomous systems, three of the people said.
In Europe, supervisors including the Bank of England and the European Central Bank are pressing banks to improve recovery plans, concerned that rapid advances in AI could cause serious harm and disruption in financial markets sooner than previously feared, three people with knowledge of their thinking said.
A senior executive at a large European bank said they too are worried about potentially major damage to banking and financial markets “within six months”.

The debate over AI oversight has intensified amid warnings from the industry after recent incidents, with JPMorgan chief executive Jamie Dimon urging corporate leaders to join a US-focused industry group to address AI risks, Reuters reported.
US cybersecurity company CrowdStrike said in October a person in China likely used a Chinese-developed AI agent and Anthropic’s Claude Code in a hack on South Korean banks. Rogue AI agents developed by OpenAI were meanwhile involved in a breach of AI platform Hugging Face , Reuters reported.
Anthropic researchers have warned that increasingly powerful AI systems could eventually escape human control and even pose an existential threat, prompting calls for stricter regulation.

Banks are competing to adopt agentic AI, which can accomplish tasks with minimal human supervision, while also grappling with the challenges of new models including IT weaknesses flagged by Anthropic’s Mythos tool.
“The adoption of AI is often outpacing the ability to put the controls in place,” said Michael Woodbridge, London-based cybersecurity partner at Grant Thornton.
US concerns aim at agentic AI The US regulatory inquiries centre on how banks use agentic AI in areas such as cybersecurity, focusing on whether AI agents are being used to identify, prioritise and respond to threats.
Questions from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and the Fed focus on what limits are placed on systems, how their actions are monitored and approved and whether banks can clearly track and audit AI agent decisions, two of the people said.
They are also asking what safeguards exist to prevent agents from exceeding their authority, whether humans remain involved in key decisions and how banks can shut down autonomous systems.
The OCC, the Fed and the FDIC declined to comment.
Through their questions, regulators are probing more specific issues tied to advanced AI models, including the use of autonomous AI agents, foreign-developed models and new cyber risks, the three people with knowledge of their thinking said.
The written and verbal inquiries to large, mid-size and smaller banks show regulators are focusing on vulnerabilities from banks’ use of AI and their preparedness to act, they added.
Regulators are still gathering information and are not yet being prescriptive about what lenders should be doing, they said.

More on this topic

Watchdog finds no Fed misconduct in renovation; Trump calls for Powell’s resignation

US Fed watchdog flags apparent data breaches by retiring staff member

Europeans worry about recovery Supervisors in Britain are separately encouraging the largest banks to examine so-called bare metal recovery plans, two of the people familiar with their thinking said. These systems are entirely independent from a bank’s main tech set-up and can kick in if primary operating systems are compromised.
Building and maintaining such state-of-the-art recovery is expensive, however, the people said.
Rather than introduce new requirements, British authorities intend to work collaboratively with industry, they added.
The BoE declined to comment.
The ECB in July gave lenders an end-October deadline to produce plans to counter AI-enabled cyber threats, including improved back-up and recovery.
Asked about its strategy for regulating AI, the ECB referred to its July letter as well as a June speech by board member Frank Elderson who stressed the need to create a sense of urgency, not alarm, about the threats.
The need for supervisory action has taken on added urgency after European banks and regulators expressed frustration at getting limited access to Mythos in 2026, amid concerns US banks will be given first sight to test frontier models.
Like their US counterparts, British supervisors are also asking banks to use frontier AI to identify vulnerabilities and accelerate patching, two people said, with one adding that lenders were so far doing a good job.
The third person said euro zone banks were also being asked to map how AI is being used across their businesses and third-party providers, to understand key dependencies and ensure they can switch off and restart systems in a controlled manner.
Significant gaps remained at some firms, they added.
“To protect against attacks, rapid recovery matters as much as prevention,” said Sukand Ramachandran, managing director and Senior Partner at BCG.
Without separately-held clean, secure copies of critical data, “a serious attack could lock customers out of their accounts and disrupt payments across the wider economy”, Ramachandran told Reuters. REUTERS

items.title: ブルガリア沖で船舶2隻にドローン攻撃、1隻沈没　首相「容認できず」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソフィア １３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソフィア １３日 ロイター] - ブルガリアのラデフ首相は１３日、同国の黒海沿岸沖で船舶２隻がドローン（無人機）による攻撃を受け、うち１隻が沈没したと明らかにした。同様の事件は１週間で２度目。

ラデフ氏によると、ブルガリア沿岸から約１８カイリ（３３キロ）沖で１３日午前１時半（１２日２２３０ＧＭＴ、日本時間１３日午前７時半）ごろ、ウクライナ所有のマルタ船籍「チェルシー３」がドローン３機の攻撃を受けて損傷した。乗組員のウクライナ人７人とアゼルバイジャン人８人は救助された。５人が医療処置を受けたが、重傷者はいなかった。

沈没した船舶の乗組員１人も救助されたという。

ラデフ氏はテレビ演説で「ブルガリア領海のすぐ近くで再び攻撃が起きた。断じて容認できない」とした上で「北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のルッテ事務総長と協議する予定だ」と語った。

攻撃の実行主体を示す明確な証拠はないとしながらも、「結果はロシアの利益になるものだ」と指摘。この事件についてロシア大使を呼び出すと述べた。

ブルガリアはウクライナともロシアとも国境を接していないが、ＮＡＴＯ加盟国として、両国が主要港を持つ黒海で戦略的に重要な位置を占める。

items.title: 'Brutal session' for chip stocks shows AI trade is turning
items.author: Tom Westbrook
items.creator: Tom Westbrook
items.summary: A selloff in AI supplier shares on Tuesday is the strongest sign to date that the mood on the trade of the decade is shifting, with worries rising interest rates could scupper a spending spree bigger than America's historic railroad boom.
items.body:
A selloff in AI supplier shares on Tuesday is the strongest sign to date that the mood on the trade of the decade is shifting, with worries rising interest rates could scupper a spending spree bigger than America's [USN:L6N45F0VB TEXT:"historic railroad boom"].
Nearly four years since the launch of OpenAI's ChatGPT, cash has [USN:L6N45R12W TEXT:"streamed into semiconductor companies"], data centre owners, cable companies and anyone reaping revenues from an unprecedented race to build computing infrastructure.
Cracks in those bets, which began in June are now widening across markets, with a data centre IPO collapsing last week in Australia and credit investors [USN:L1N45702I TEXT:"becoming picky"] on AI debt.
In Asia, selling of Korean chipmaker shares extended into a fifth straight day on Tuesday, accelerating sharply, with the KOSPI index falling more than 6% while in Tokyo memory-maker Kioxia (285A.T) , down 13%, led AI-related losses.
The falls are the heaviest since the same sort of stocks collapsed at the end of July. The KOSPI is on its longest losing streak for more than two years, down a quarter from July highs, while Shanghai's tech-focused STAR Market (.CSI000680) has lost more than a third from July peaks.
"The most important development has been not just bond yields going up, but the volatility for bonds ... and that's starting to work its way out through asset pricing across the board," said Damien Boey, portfolio strategist at Wilson Asset Management in Sydney.
"It's a very uncomfortable situation on many fronts ... maybe AI capex just comes off the boil a little bit, and maybe a few players are casualties in that."
The US benchmark Philadelphia semiconductor index (.SOX) dropped 2.7% on Monday and even heavier selling drove Seoul-listed chipmakers Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) down by 10% and 8%, respectively.
On Monday, the research arm of BlackRock, the world's biggest asset manager, downgraded its US stocks outlook to neutral, citing "potential volatility around the AI buildout" and turned bullish on short-term Treasuries.
"The consequences of an AI correction could be global," the International Monetary Fund warned on Tuesday in its latest [USN:L6N45Y0TS TEXT:"financial stability report"].
The IMF called out AI's contribution to growth but said there was growing evidence that capability investments and economic gains may not be as big as expected.
COST OF CAPITAL Caution is also coursing through [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"primary markets"].
Last week, Firmus, a data centre operator backed by Nvidia (NVDA.O) , [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"shelved a $5 billion IPO"] in Australia as investor interest shrivelled, underscoring how suddenly risks are becoming the chief focus in allocating capital to the sector.
Tuesday's dollar and dim sum bond sale by [USN:L1N45Z00N TEXT:"Tencent Holdings"] (0700.HK) in Hong Kong was the latest deal in debt markets' sights, with guidance for 10-year dollar notes about 1.15 percentage points on top of Treasury yields, which sit at 5.2%.
Japan's tech investor [USN:L6N45F1AU TEXT:"SoftBank"] (9984.T) last month sold the biggest high-yield debt pile ever and promised to pay as much as 9.75% on $4.5 billion it raised at a 7-1/2 year tenor.
The mood shift was [USN:L4N45T0O0 TEXT:"front of mind"] at a slew of top financial conferences in Singapore, most recently on Monday when [USN:L6N45Y0A4 TEXT:"Broadcom's CEO"] said capital was the biggest constraint on growth.
To be sure, few are calling time on the AI trade altogether and on Monday [USN:L4N45Y13Q TEXT:"Meta"] (META.O) shares jumped 3.4% on the release of a new AI model, but many see semiconductors as a warning sign.
Marc Velan, head of investments at Lucerne Asset Management in Singapore, believes the "brutal session" in Korea said more about positioning and the cost of capital than about any fundamental deterioration in AI demand.
"I suspect we're entering the next phase of the AI cycle, where markets increasingly focus on monetisation and returns on invested capital — I wouldn't call this the end of the AI trade," Velan said. "But Korea could be an early warning of a broader shakeout."

items.title: Blues prospect Dylan Peterson to make NHL debut in Ottawa
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: St. Louis center Dylan Peterson is scheduled to make his NHL debut Tuesday night when the Blues visit the Ottawa Senators.
items.body:
St. Louis center Dylan Peterson is scheduled to make his NHL debut Tuesday night when the Blues visit the Ottawa Senators.
Peterson, 24, will be playing in familiar territory after being recalled from AHL Springfield on Saturday.
Though Peterson was born in Roseville, Calif., his family moved around a lot. The Ottawa area was one of their stops, and Peterson played minor hockey there.
"I've got a lot of family. I played in Ottawa quite a bit growing up," he said. "It's a lot of family and friends and it's just going to be really special to share it with them."
Peterson skated on the fourth line along with Pius Suter and Ross Johnston during practice on Monday.
"He's been playing well down there (in Springfield)," Blues coach Jim Montgomery said. "He is your prototypical fourth-line player. We're going on the road here for three games and we think he's going to add an edge to our game and more of a fourth-line presence."
St. Louis defeated the visiting Columbus Blue Jackets 5-3 on Saturday night to end a three-game losing streak (0-2-1).
Jonatan Berggren's goal 9:33 into the third period broke a 3-3 tie after St. Louis rallied from a 2-0 deficit.
Jimmy Snuggerud had two goals, Jake Neighbours also scored and Pavel Buchnevich added an empty-net tally. Dylan Holloway dished out three assists, and Jordan Binnington made 20 saves.
The top line of Snuggerud, Holloway and center Robert Thomas combined for six points as Thomas picked up an assist. He and Holloway each earned their first points of the season.
Snuggerud tops the team with three goals through the first five games. His four points are tied for first along with Connor McMichael and Mason McTavish, who have two goals and two assists each.
The Senators (5-1-0) are off to their best start since 2007-08 after a 4-1 victory over the host New Jersey Devils on Monday night to celebrate Canadian Thanksgiving.
Tim Stutzle continued his hot start with a goal and an assist to give him five goals and 10 points. He paces the squad in both categories for the young season.
"It's great. We're playing good hockey," Stutzle said.
Linus Ullmark made 29 saves for his fifth win in five games in 2026-27, dropping his goals-against average to 1.27 and raising his save percentage to .948. Ullmark was denied the shutout with 5:01 left.
However, with the Senators playing back-to-back games, Samuel Ersson (0-1, 3.85 GAA, .886 save percentage in two games) likely will get the start on Tuesday against the Blues.
Ottawa's Shane Pinto, Stephen Halliday (power play) and defenseman Tyler Kleven (empty net) also scored on Monday.
The Senators probably will continue to be without defensemen Jake Sanderson (lower body) and Artem Zub (knee), according to coach Travis Green. Sanderson was injured in the season opener, and Zub has yet to suit up in 2026-27.
"I don't think either one of them will play (Tuesday)," Green said. "Hopefully, we'll see them soon, though."
Defenseman Nikolas Matinpalo left the game with an upper-body injury in the middle of the first period after being sent awkwardly to the boards from behind by the Devils' Anthony Mantha, who received a five-minute boarding major.
"It's pretty obvious what the injury is," Green said. "We'll have to wait and see how he is (Tuesday)."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Produktion von Lebkuchen sinkt um zehn Prozent - Gefragt im Ausland
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Alle Jahre wieder: Schon Wochen vor der Weihnachtszeit sind die Supermarktregale gut mit Lebkuchen gefüllt. Allerdings ist in Deutschland die Produktion dieser Leckerei zuletzt deutlich zurückgegangen. Sie sank im vergangenen Jahr um zehn Prozent auf gut 72.800 Tonnen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag mitteilte. Dies war der niedrigste Wert der vergangenen sieben Jahre.
items.body:
Alle Jahre wieder: Schon Wochen vor der Weihnachtszeit sind die Supermarktregale gut mit Lebkuchen gefüllt. Allerdings ist in Deutschland die Produktion dieser Leckerei zuletzt deutlich zurückgegangen. Sie sank im vergangenen Jahr um zehn Prozent auf gut 72.800 Tonnen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag mitteilte. Dies war der niedrigste Wert der vergangenen sieben Jahre.
Damit die Waren rechtzeitig zum Weihnachtsgeschäft in den Handel gelangen, fahren die Hersteller ihre Produktion bereits im Sommer hoch. So entfiel 2025 mehr als ein Drittel der Jahresproduktion auf die Monate Juli bis September.
Lebkuchen aus Deutschland sind auch im Ausland gefragt. Im Jahr 2025 wurden knapp 20.000 Tonnen des Weihnachtsgebäcks exportiert, der Großteil davon ging ins europäische Ausland. Wichtigste Abnehmer waren Österreich mit 4200 Tonnen, Polen mit 3700 Tonnen und Frankreich mit 2100 Tonnen. Etwa die Hälfte der deutschen Lebkuchen-Exporte ging damit in diese drei Nachbarländer. Außerhalb Europas waren die USA mit 1100 Tonnen der wichtigste Markt, es folgten Australien (400 Tonnen) und Brasilien (300 Tonnen).
Zugleich importierte Deutschland gut 10.000 Tonnen Lebkuchen. Der größte Teil davon kam mit 5300 Tonnen aus dem Nachbarland Polen, was einem Anteil von 53 Prozent entspricht. Weitere elf Prozent stammten jeweils aus Italien und der Ukraine (je 1100 Tonnen).
Von besonderer Bedeutung für das Geschäft ist die zweite Jahreshälfte. Fast 90 Prozent der Ausfuhren fanden 2025 in diesem Zeitraum statt. Die exportstärksten Monate waren dabei der August und September, in denen zusammen fast die Hälfte aller Lebkuchen-Exporte getätigt wurden.
Die Statistik erfasst dabei Betriebe von Unternehmen mit 20 oder mehr Beschäftigten. Die offizielle Güterbezeichnung lautet "Leb- und Honigkuchen und ähnliche Waren".

items.title: Market turns cold on luxury after LVMH's China letdown
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: LVMH's weaker-than-expected quarterly fashion and leather goods sales, hit by a deterioration in Chinese consumer demand for its flagship Louis Vuitton brand, have raised fresh doubts about the luxury industry's recovery prospects.
items.body:
LVMH's (LVMH.PA) weaker-than-expected quarterly [USN:L6N45Y0VL TEXT:"fashion and leather goods sales"], hit by a deterioration in Chinese consumer demand for its flagship Louis Vuitton brand, have raised fresh doubts about the luxury industry's recovery prospects.
Four sell-side analysts have cut their target price on LVMH shares by an average 9% following the results, the first quarterly report by a major sector player, expecting the miss to also signal weak performance at some of its competitors.
LVMH shares were down 1.5% by 0730 GMT. Its peers Hermes (HRMS.PA) , Kering (PRTP.PA) and Richemont (CFR.S) were down by a similar degree.
Europe's leading luxury groups, mired in a three-year slowdown, have lost around €330 billion in market value since the start of the year, with LVMH alone shedding roughly 40%.
"Despite the recent share price weakness, we expect some further pressure on the space as a whole today, with confirmation that the Chinese cluster seems to have taken a material (and bigger than feared) step down", JPMorgan analysts said in a note to clients.
RECOVERY TO TAKE TIME, CFO SAYS LVMH on Monday posted a 5% drop in organic sales at its fashion and leather goods division, which generates nearly half of group revenue, missing expectations in a Visible Alpha consensus for a 1.8% decline.
The group said a "less buoyant environment" in China impacted its revenues, contributing to 1% organic sales growth overall, excluding currency swings, to €18.5 billion ($20.68 billion), below expectations for 1.3% growth.
Asked about Louis Vuitton's recovery prospects in a call with analysts, the group's Chief Financial Officer Cecile Cabanis said: "It takes a bit of time, but I don't think there are a lot of shortcuts here".
Adding to investor concerns, growth in LVMH's watches and jewellery division, home to brands including Bulgari and Tiffany, slowed to 6% from 9% in the first half of the year, marking a changing trend in one of luxury's few bright spots.
($1 = 0.8947 euros)

items.title: Muere a los 34 años RJ Mitte, actor de "Breaking Bad" y defensor de las personas con discapacidad
items.author: Steve Gorman
items.creator: Steve Gorman
items.summary: El actor RJ Mitte, cuya experiencia personal al vivir con parálisis cerebral sirvió de inspiración para su papel de Walter White Jr., el hijo con discapacidad física de un capo de la metanfetamina en la emblemática serie de televisión "Breaking Bad", falleció el lunes a los 34 años.
items.body:
El actor RJ Mitte, cuya experiencia personal al vivir con parálisis cerebral sirvió de inspiración para su papel de Walter White Jr., el hijo con discapacidad física de un capo de la metanfetamina en la emblemática serie de televisión "Breaking Bad", falleció el lunes a los 34 años.
La noticia de la muerte de Mitte en Brownsville, Texas, se dio a conocer en un comunicado difundido a través de su agencia de representación. Un portavoz del actor confirmó posteriormente los reportes de que Mitte se había quitado la vida. No se dieron más detalles sobre las circunstancias.
"Con profunda tristeza comunicamos el trágico fallecimiento del querido actor, filántropo y apasionado defensor de los derechos de las personas con discapacidad RJ Mitte", decía el comunicado inicial.
El protagonista de "Breaking Bad", Bryan Cranston, expresó en las redes sociales su "profunda desesperación" por la muerte de su "querido hijo".
Mitte era conocido sobre todo por el papel que le catapultó al éxito en la serie de televisión por cable de AMC "Breaking Bad", en la que interpretaba al hijo único del personaje principal de Cranston, Walter White, un profesor de instituto con una enfermedad terminal que se ve abocado a una vida secreta dedicada al crimen fabricando metanfetamina cristalina.
La aclamada serie, a menudo citada por la crítica como uno de los mejores dramas televisivos de todos los tiempos, se emitió entre 2008 y 2013, y obtuvo 16 premios Emmy, incluidos dos a la mejor serie dramática. Mitte tenía 14 años cuando fue elegido para el episodio piloto, cuyo rodaje comenzó en 2007, explicó Cranston.
Inspirándose en su propia lucha contra la parálisis cerebral, un trastorno crónico del control muscular, Mitte aportó un grado excepcional de autenticidad a un personaje televisivo cuya discapacidad física se representaba como algo en gran medida secundario para la trama.
Su interpretación de Walter "Flynn" White Jr., que caminaba con muletas y hablaba con dificultad, llamó pronto la atención de los seguidores, que lo apodaron "el rey del desayuno" por sus apariciones recurrentes en escenas en torno a la mesa del desayuno familiar.
Pero su papel fue cobrando protagonismo a medida que avanzaba la trama de la serie. Empieza siendo un adolescente despreocupado que admira a su padre, pero luego se ve obligado a afrontar la desintegración de la familia a medida que sale a la luz la verdad sobre el alter ego de Walter White, "Heisenberg", fabricante de metanfetamina.
En un comunicado publicado en Instagram el lunes por la noche, Cranston rindió homenaje a Mitte, describiéndolo como un "excelente actor" y un "defensor acérrimo de los intérpretes con discapacidad".
"Es especialmente devastador saber que se quitó la vida", escribió Cranston, que añadió que él y Mitte "se estaban enviando mensajes de texto hace solo unas semanas" sobre la posibilidad de quedar para comer.
"No sé si ese almuerzo habría cambiado su futuro", escribió Cranston. "Pero sí sé que le quería y que disfruté muchísimo de su compañía a lo largo de todos los años que duró la serie, y también después de que se apagaran los focos de 'Breaking Bad'. Te echaré de menos, hijo".
A pesar de su discapacidad, Mitte "nunca —jamás— permitió que ese reto fuera una excusa para nada" durante la producción de la serie, recordó Cranston. "Afrontó el exigente calendario de rodaje con gran determinación".
Más tarde, Mitte interpretó a un cómico de monólogos con parálisis cerebral en la comedia romántica de 2019 "Standing Up for Sunny" y a un luchador de instituto con parálisis cerebral en la película sobre el paso a la madurez de 2021 "Triumph".
Mitte, en cuyo currículum también figuran las películas "The Recall" y "The Oak Room", había estado trabajando en la promoción de una nueva película, "Talking to Strangers", y había aparecido como invitado en un podcast para hablar de la película en los últimos días, según la publicación especializada de Hollywood Variety.
Fuera de la pantalla, Mitte ejercía de portavoz del Sindicato de Actores de Cine (Screen Actors Guild) para los intérpretes con discapacidad y era un embajador famoso de la fundación United Cerebral Palsy.
Nacido en Jackson, Misisipi, Mitte sufrió daño cerebral al nacer, fue adoptado cuando era un bebé y le diagnosticaron parálisis cerebral a los 3 años. Durante gran parte de su infancia tuvo que llevar ortesis en las piernas y muletas, pero gracias al deporte y al ejercicio físico acabó superando la necesidad de utilizar estos dispositivos para caminar.
Según Wikipedia, Mitte fue criado por su madre adoptiva tras la separación de sus padres y asumió la responsabilidad económica de su hermana menor y de su madre a los 13 años, después de que esta quedara paralítica.
items.raw_description: El actor RJ Mitte, cuya experiencia personal al vivir con parálisis cerebral sirvió de inspiración para su papel de Walter White Jr., el hijo con discapacidad física de un capo de la metanfetamina en la emblemática serie de televisión "Breaking Bad", falleció el lunes a los 34 años.

items.title: Guardians' Parker Messick back home for ALCS road start vs. Rays
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Cleveland Guardians have made themselves at home on the road thus far during their run through the postseason.
items.body:
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Cleveland Guardians have made themselves at home on the road thus far during their run through the postseason.
While the road has been kind, the Guardians will turn to Plant City, Fla., native Parker Messick on Tuesday when they play Game 2 of their best-of-seven American League Championship Series against the Tampa Bay Rays.
Messick (0-1, 5.40 ERA postseason) said "a pretty large group of people" will make the approximate 45-minute trek to Tropicana Field to cheer him on.
The Florida State product, a 25-year-old rookie left-hander, fared well in both of his outings for Cleveland at the Rays. He allowed a total of two runs in 13 2/3 innings, including one run over 7 2/3 frames on July 26.
"I think I've handled it both times pretty well, both starts have been fine," Messick said on Monday, hours before the Guardians rallied for a 7-3 win in the ALCS opener. "So I anticipate this just being another day I get to see family and get to pitch in front of the people that care most about me.
Added Guardians manager Stephen Vogt: "He's had two straight very good starts here in front of his family and friends. It's always a special boost when you get to play at home as a player."
Messick is 2-1 with a 1.03 ERA in four career appearances (all starts) versus Tampa Bay.
He yielded two runs for his second straight postseason outing against the Chicago White Sox on Thursday. He escaped with a no-decision despite matching a career high with four walks in 2 1/3 innings.
"You can definitely tell it's October baseball, but everyone goes through it," said Messick, who went 12-9 with a 2.56 ERA in 32 regular-season starts this year. "You've got to find a way to dig deep and keep going. I feel great, though."
So did his teammates, as the Guardians scored all seven of their runs on Monday over the final four innings. They have erupted for 25 during their three road playoff games.
In-season acquisitions Nathaniel Lowe, Jo Adell and Patrick Bailey combined for five hits and five RBIs in the series opener. Lowe ripped a tiebreaking two-run single in the eighth inning, while Bailey and rookie Chase DeLauter homered for Cleveland.
Jose Ramirez and DeLauter each had three of the 14 hits by the Guardians, who handed the Rays their first loss of the playoffs.
Rays right-hander Freddy Peralta (0-0, 1.93 ERA postseason) will attempt to keep Cleveland's bats in check when he makes the start on Tuesday.
Peralta posted a 5-0 record with a 0.79 ERA over his last six regular-season starts before receiving a no-decision against the Yankees on Oct. 5. He limited New York to one run on three hits in 4 2/3 innings.
Peralta, 30, is 1-2 with a 4.00 ERA in four career appearances (three starts) against Cleveland.
Tampa Bay also seems to have avoided a significant injury after left fielder Jonny DeLuca collided with third baseman Junior Caminero while chasing a ninth-inning fly ball in foul territory on Monday. Caminero remained on the field for several moments before getting to his feet. He remained in the game.
"He's OK," Rays manager Kevin Cash said postgame about Caminero. "I think he just got the wind knocked out of him. He seems to be totally fine now."
--Field Level Media

items.title: El róver Perseverance, de la NASA, bate en Marte el récord de distancia recorrida fuera de la Tierra
items.author: Will Dunham
items.creator: Will Dunham
items.summary: El róver robótico Perseverance de la NASA ha recorrido ya más distancia que cualquier otro vehículo en la superficie de un planeta que no es la Tierra, acumulando 45,2 kilómetros desde su llegada a Marte en 2021, informó este martes la agencia espacial estadounidense.
items.body:
El róver robótico Perseverance de la NASA ha recorrido ya más distancia que cualquier otro vehículo en la superficie de un planeta que no es la Tierra, acumulando 45,2 kilómetros desde su llegada a Marte en 2021, informó este martes la agencia espacial estadounidense.
El róver, del tamaño de un automóvil y con seis ruedas, alcanzó este hito tras cinco años y medio de misión, cuyo objetivo es investigar si alguna vez existieron condiciones propicias para la vida microbiana en el vecino de la Tierra.
Al hacerlo, está recorriendo algunos de los terrenos más antiguos jamás encontrados en el sistema solar.
"El 'hardware' y los instrumentos de Perseverance se encuentran en excelente estado y todos los sistemas redundantes siguen operativos", declaró a Reuters Steven Lee, del Laboratorio de Propulsión a Chorro de la NASA en California.
"Una evaluación reciente de todos los sistemas concluyó que son capaces de funcionar hasta bien entrados los años 2030, y probablemente más allá", añadió Lee, director de proyecto de los dos róveres marcianos de la NASA, el Perseverance y el Curiosity.
El Perseverance ha superado la cifra anterior de 45 kilómetros recorridos sobre la superficie marciana por el róver Opportunity de la NASA entre 2004 y 2018. Ambos han superado también las distancias recorridas por cualquier róver lunar.
RECORRIENDO EL CRÁTER JEZERO El Perseverance, con su conjunto de instrumentos científicos, se ha centrado en el cráter Jezero, una región del hemisferio norte de Marte que se cree que estuvo inundada de agua y albergó una cuenca lacustre hace miles de millones de años.
El róver alcanzó este hito en su viaje hacia una zona llamada Idubi, atravesando la región situada junto al borde occidental del cráter, conocida como Lac de Charmes.
Su compañero, el Curiosity, se desplaza por el cráter Gale, cerca del ecuador marciano.
"Perseverance no da señales de ralentizarse", añadió Lee.
Se están probando los mecanismos de su sistema de movilidad para demostrar que puede recorrer 100 kilómetros o más, explicó, y el "hardware" se someterá a pruebas equivalentes a una distancia de entre 150 kilómetros y 300 kilómetros en el marco de esta iniciativa.
La NASA atribuyó gran parte del éxito del Perseverance a su capacidad de conducción autónoma, un sistema de navegación autónomo denominado AutoNav. Lee señaló que el 90% de sus desplazamientos se realizan de forma autónoma, sin intervención humana.
"El Perseverance toma imágenes estereoscópicas del terreno que tiene delante, genera un mapa 3D mediante 'software' y selecciona la ruta más segura hacia el objetivo del trayecto", explicó.
Otro componente clave es el Vision Compute Element, un coprocesador rápido que permite al róver procesar imágenes y ejecutar su software de conducción autónoma con gran rapidez, casi de forma continua durante los desplazamientos, añadió Lee.
Esto contrasta con los róveres anteriores, que necesitaban hacer una pausa para "pensar" antes de cada tramo del recorrido, señaló.
"El Perseverance se basa en el legado de 29 años de nuestros anteriores róveres marcianos —Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity y Curiosity—, cada uno de los cuales incorpora las lecciones aprendidas y mejora nuestra capacidad para desplazarnos por otro mundo", dijo Lee.

items.title: UK grocery inflation accelerates over last month, says Worldpanel
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British grocery price inflation accelerated to 2.5% over the four weeks to October 4, market researcher Worldpanel by Numerator said on Tuesday, putting more pressure on households already facing higher motor fuel and energy bills.
items.body:
British grocery price inflation accelerated to 2.5% over the four weeks to October 4, market researcher Worldpanel by Numerator said on Tuesday, putting more pressure on households already facing higher motor fuel and [USN:L6N44N0BE TEXT:"energy bills"].
The figure compared to 2.3% in last month's report, with prices rising fastest in products such as water, cordials and skincare and falling fastest in butter, cheese and chocolate.
The Worldpanel data is the most up-to-date snapshot of UK consumer behaviour, providing an early indication of food pricing pressures in October. [USN:L8N45806W TEXT:"Official UK inflation data"] for September will be published on October 21
UK food inflation has [USN:L8N445044 TEXT:"not hit the levels"] that were forecast earlier in the year, reflecting fierce supermarket competition, consumers' resistance to further price rises and better hedging in the industry
Industry groups [USN:L8N4570P2 TEXT:"predict"] UK food inflation will hit nearly 7% in 2027, driven by Middle East disruption, rising input costs and extreme weather linked to El Nino
The Worldpanel data showed UK grocery sales increased 1.0% over the four weeks year-on-year, indicating lower sales on a volume basis once inflation is taken into account
Over the 12 weeks to October 4, [USN:L8N45U08P TEXT:"industry leader"] Tesco's (TSCO.L) sales rose 1.0% year-on-year, but its market share edged lower for the fifth report in a row
While Marks & Spencer (MKS.L) isn't fully included in the Worldpanel data set, it remained the UK's fastest-growing food retailer with a 14.9% rise in sales of groceries
Separate [USN:S8N42Q0C8 TEXT:"survey data"] published on Tuesday showed British consumers kept a lid on overall spending in September, with warm weather helping pubs but hurting clothing sales

ダルトンは保有目的として、イワキの株価が過小評価されており、魅力的な投資機会と考えて、長期的な保有のための取得すると説明。同社のコーポレートガバナンスや取締役会の構成などに関して建設的な対話を求める可能性もあるとした。昨年１２月には非公開化やスピンオフを含むすべての経営戦略オプションを予断なく検証するよう提案する書簡を同社を含むすべての投資先に送付しており、今後もこの書簡の趣旨に沿ってイワキとの対話を進める予定とした。

US says it opposes Chinese 'coercion', after Belize and Paraguay ministers sanctioned

A Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said in response that the United States should "stop sending the wrong signals to Taiwan separatist forces".

Paraguay President Santiago Pena attends a welcoming ceremony with Taiwan leader Lai Ching-te in Taipei, Taiwan, on May 8, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Ann Wang)

TAIPEI: The Trump administration opposes "coercion and aggression" by China against countries for exercising their sovereign rights, the US State Department said, after Beijing sanctioned Belizean and Paraguayan ministers over their ties to Taiwan.
A Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said in response that the United States should "stop sending the wrong signals to Taiwan separatist forces".
Paraguay and Belize are two of just 12 countries to maintain formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan. China says Taiwan is one of its provinces with no right to behave like a state, a view Taipei's government strongly rejects.
The sanctions are largely symbolic because ministers from Taiwan's diplomatic allies generally do not travel to China. Beijing has previously imposed similar measures mainly on Western politicians for their support of democratically governed Taiwan.

"The Trump administration opposes coercion and aggression by China against countries in our hemisphere for exercising their sovereign rights," State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a statement.
Pigott cited previous comments by Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the US "will not allow our region to become a base of operation for adversaries, competitors, and rivals to threaten our security or undermine our partnerships".
"We stand with our friends and partners, including Taiwan, to advance our shared prosperity, security, and values," Pigott added.
The United States is Taiwan's most important international backer, despite the lack of formal diplomatic ties.
Washington has been concerned not only by Beijing's efforts to win over Taiwan's remaining allies, but also by attempts to increase its influence in Latin America.

Related:

Decoding Japan PM Takaichi’s ‘important neighbour’ message to China - what it means for ties

TAIWAN'S VISIBILITY "GROWING HIGHER" Speaking on Tuesday (Oct 13) to reporters at parliament in Taipei, Taiwan Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi said China was extending "transnational repression" to Taiwan's allies.
"Taiwan's international visibility is growing higher and higher, and they will be kept busy by this fact," Chen said, referring to China. "Do they plan to sanction the whole world?"
Taiwan Premier Cho Jung-tai said Beijing had no right to interfere in the domestic affairs of, or influence the diplomacy of, any sovereign and independent state, "including the Republic of China", referring to the island's formal name.
"At the same time, we will resist any expansion of hegemony or authoritarianism," he added, also speaking at parliament.
China has stepped up pressure on Taiwan's remaining diplomatic allies to sever ties with Taipei.
The last country to do so was the tiny Pacific Island nation of Nauru, in 2024. Honduras ended its decades-long ties with Taiwan in 2023.

Source: Reuters/ec

TAIWAN'S VISIBILITY "GROWING HIGHER" Speaking on Tuesday (Oct 13) to reporters at parliament in Taipei, Taiwan Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi said China was extending "transnational repression" to Taiwan's allies.
"Taiwan's international visibility is growing higher and higher, and they will be kept busy by this fact," Chen said, referring to China. "Do they plan to sanction the whole world?"
Taiwan Premier Cho Jung-tai said Beijing had no right to interfere in the domestic affairs of, or influence the diplomacy of, any sovereign and independent state, "including the Republic of China", referring to the island's formal name.
"At the same time, we will resist any expansion of hegemony or authoritarianism," he added, also speaking at parliament.
China has stepped up pressure on Taiwan's remaining diplomatic allies to sever ties with Taipei.
The last country to do so was the tiny Pacific Island nation of Nauru, in 2024. Honduras ended its decades-long ties with Taiwan in 2023.

items.title: Wallabies back Suaalii says wing switch will help him on road to becoming great
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Wallabies back Joseph-Aukuso Suaalii has endorsed his move to the wing, saying it will make him a better all-round player, as Australia continues to debate where the former rugby league sensation is best deployed.
items.body:
Wallabies back Joseph-Aukuso Suaalii has endorsed his move to the wing, saying it will make him a better all-round player, as Australia continues to debate where the former rugby league sensation is best deployed.
Suaalii has played predominantly in the centres since crossing from the National Rugby League's Sydney Roosters two years ago but Wallabies coach Les Kiss started him on the wing in the last two tests, including Saturday's 50-19 Bledisloe Cup thrashing by New Zealand at Eden Park.
His ideal position continues to be a talking point in Australian rugby but the 23-year-old says his shift out wide can only accelerate his development.
"Part of my journey of learning to be a great rugby player is to learn different positions, and I'm enjoying it," he told reporters on Tuesday.
"Seeing the game from a different perspective helps me be a better centre, helps me be a better fullback ... so I'm really enjoying it."
Eden Park was a setback both for the Wallabies, who suffered their first test loss under Kiss, and for Suaalii, whose skills under the high ball were nullified by an All Blacks team who won the aerial battle decisively.
The result also ended Australia's hopes of wresting back the Bledisloe Cup, with New Zealand retaining the annual trophy contested by the nations for a 24th straight year.
Suaalii may yet end up redeployed in the midfield for the second Bledisloe test in Sydney on Saturday following injuries to Len Ikitau and Jordan Petaia, and Hunter Paisami's suspension.
He was confident the Wallabies would respond after Eden Park where they challenged for a half before being blown away.
"We reviewed the game brutally and honestly as well," he said.
“There’s a bigger plan to what we’re doing ... we’re real confident that this week we’ll be great.”

items.title: Anthropic: modelli IA presto potrebbero replicarsi senza accedere a data center
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic oggi ha comunicato che alcuni esperimenti hanno dimostrato come i modelli di IA di piccole dimensioni potrebbero, nel giro di pochi mesi, essere in grado di autoreplicarsi sui dispositivi dell’Internet delle cose (IoT), come forni intelligenti e Tv box Android non di marca.
items.body:
Anthropic oggi ha comunicato che alcuni esperimenti hanno dimostrato come i modelli di IA di piccole dimensioni potrebbero, nel giro di pochi mesi, essere in grado di autoreplicarsi sui dispositivi dell’Internet delle cose (IoT), come forni intelligenti e Tv box Android non di marca.
Nei propri esperimenti, Anthropic ha verificato se i modelli di IA fossero in grado di individuare dispositivi vulnerabili, copiarsi su di essi e continuare a diffondersi senza l’intervento umano.
È emerso che i modelli di piccole dimensioni, con meno di 30 miliardi di parametri, sono in grado di completare i numerosi passaggi necessari per la replicazione.
Tuttavia l’azienda ha riscontrato che questi modelli hanno avuto delle difficoltà a completare l’intera sequenza dall’inizio alla fine.
Nei test semplificati, in cui sono state eliminate alcune misure di sicurezza, Anthropic ha scoperto che il modello GLM-5.2 e altri modelli più potenti sono riusciti a eseguire una replica end-to-end.
I modelli in grado di replicarsi sarebbero difficili da disattivare dal momento che non esiste un punto di spegnimento centralizzato e, a differenza dei malware non basati sull’IA, potrebbero anche individuare dispositivi sconosciuti in modo autonomo, colpendo i processori dei data center.
Nella sua ricerca, l’azienda si è concentrata su dispositivi IoT come le Tv Android, gli elettrodomestici intelligenti e altri gadget connessi a Internet, poiché in genere poco protetti.
Il colosso dell’IA ha inoltre avvertito che, se i modelli di piccole dimensioni dovessero continuare a migliorare al ritmo finora osservato, sarebbero in grado di replicarsi autonomamente entro la fine di quest’anno, seguiti dai cosiddetti 'weight-based replicator' di piccole dimensioni.
Anthropic ha inoltre detto che è probabile che tali sistemi di IA si replichino lentamente e facciano affidamento su risorse di calcolo ampiamente disponibili e relativamente poco sicure. Ha aggiunto che sarà necessario rafforzare i dispositivi per rendere più difficile la diffusione di tali agenti IA.

items.title: 日経平均は4日続落、ＡＩ・半導体株が軒並み下げる　循環物色も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Hiroko Hamada

[東京 １３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Hiroko Hamada

[東京 １３日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は４日続落し、前営業日比１．８２％（１２５３円４０銭）安の６万７７７７円５２銭で取引を終えた。前日の米ハイテク株安の流れを引き継ぐ形で、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が軒並み下落し、指数を押し下げた。日経平均は一時、２０００円近く値下がりした。一方、バリュー（割安）株には買いが入るなど、循環的な物色もみられた。

日経平均は前営業日比０．６８％安でスタートした後、下げ幅を拡大し、前場中盤に一時２．８６％（１９７２円）安の６万７０５８円５６銭で安値を付けた。指数寄与度の大きい半導体関連株が大幅安となり、相場の重しとなった。一方、プライム市場では７割超の銘柄が上昇し、相場全体が崩れる展開にはならなかった。物色面では、海運株やエネルギー関連株、銀行株などが堅調だった。後場に入ってからは日経平均は下げ渋り、終盤はもみ合いとなった。

市場では「ＡＩ・半導体関連株は中長期でみると上昇していくとみられるが、短期では開発ペースの鈍化懸念や競争激化などの材料で売りが出やすい。日経平均も上値が重くなるのではないか」（三菱ＵＦＪアセットマネジメントのエグゼクティブファンドマネージャー・石金淳氏）との声が聞かれた。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．１４％高の４１１０．６７ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．１３％高の２１１８．８２ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆９６４０億１２００万円だった。東証３３業種では、海運、石油・石炭製品、卸売など２６業種が値上がり。非鉄金属、電機機器、金属製品など７業種が値下がりした。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が反落し、１．１９％安の７９７．０４ポイントだった。

個別では、キオクシアホールディングスが１３％超安と大幅下落。中国の半導体メーカー、長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）が次世代ＤＲＡＭ設計における進展を発表したことを受け、今後の競争激化が懸念された。その他、東京エレクトロン、ソフトバンクグループなども大幅下落。

一方、トヨタ自動車やリクルートホールディングスが上昇。後場に自社株買いを公表した竹内製作所は急伸し、５％高となった。前週末に決算を発表した安川電機はしっかりだった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１４０銘柄（７３％）、値下がりは３８０銘柄（２４％）、変わらずは３２銘柄（２％）だった。

items.title: India's NTPC seeks overseas buyers for green ammonia, low-carbon fuels
items.author: Sethuraman R
items.creator: Sethuraman R
items.summary: India's top power producer NTPC is in talks with potential buyers in Japan, South Korea and Germany for green ammonia and other low-carbon fuels, Chairman Gurdeep Singh said on Tuesday.
items.body:
India's top power producer NTPC (NTPC.NS) is in talks with potential buyers in Japan, South Korea and Germany for green ammonia and other low-carbon fuels, Chairman Gurdeep Singh said on Tuesday.
India has outlined [USN:L4N3ZU0B2 TEXT:"plans"] to become a major green hydrogen producer, even as developers worldwide have struggled to secure the long-term offtake agreements required to underpin large-scale investments
NTPC is in talks with prospective overseas customers as it develops a proposed green hydrogen hub in the southern state of Andhra Pradesh, Singh said at an event organised by the Indian Chamber of Commerce
The project is expected to produce green ammonia and green methanol, which are considered more practical than hydrogen for transportation and international trade
"We have to make hydrogen a business," Singh said, adding that the focus was shifting from pilot projects to commercially viable ventures
The comments underscore efforts by [USN:L4N40419C TEXT:"Indian companies"] to secure demand as they seek to turn government-backed hydrogen ambitions into commercially viable projects
Backed by subsidies of roughly $2.1 billion, New Delhi aims to produce 5 million metric tons of green hydrogen annually by 2030
Demand for green fuels is expected to rise as industries look for alternatives to fossil fuels to reduce missions and meet decarbonisation targets

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iga Swiatek has played at every edition of the WTA Finals since 2021, but with the Pole running out of time to claim a place at this year's season-ending tournament she knows the importance of going deep at her few remaining events.
items.body:
Iga Swiatek has played at every edition of the WTA Finals since 2021, but with the Pole running out of time to claim a place at this year's season-ending tournament she knows the importance of going deep at her few remaining events.
The six-time major champion has won only one tournament this year at the Canadian Open in August and failed to advance beyond the quarter-final stage at all four Grand Slams.
The 25-year-old, who won the WTA Finals in 2023, is 10th in the qualifying table for the November 8-15 tournament at Indian Wells with only four of the eight spots still up for grabs.
She sits on 3,799 points, 111 behind Ukraine's Marta Kostyuk in 9th place. Karolina Muchova, on 4,615 points, is the lowest-ranked player not to have sealed qualification.
"Obviously I'm aware of the situation and it would be great to get into the Finals, for sure it's our goal," Swiatek told reporters on Monday ahead of the Wuhan Open.
"It's the first time I've faced a situation like that, to get into the finals.
"It's a challenge, but I feel like it's a positive one and I'm really motivated ... There are still a few tournaments ahead."
Swiatek said she had made some positive changes to her game under coach Francisco Roig, whom she appointed in April after parting ways with Wim Fissette.
"I needed to change some stuff, and Francisco has a really great idea for my game, and I feel like we're developing my game on the practice court quite a lot, and it's been good progress," she added.
"The US Open swing, for sure, was the most positive part of the season, so that shows that I'm going in the right direction."
Swiatek, who faces compatriot Magdalena Frech in her opening match in Wuhan on Wednesday, is also scheduled to compete at WTA 500 events in Ningbo and Tokyo before the WTA Finals slots are wrapped up.

items.title: Paul Bettany says Marvel transformed his life after he was told his career was over
items.author: Francesca Halliwell
items.creator: Francesca Halliwell
items.summary: British actor Paul Bettany said Marvel has transformed his career and personal life after an unlikely twist of fate over a decade ago saw him offered the role of Vision moments after being told his Hollywood career was over.
items.body:
British actor Paul Bettany said Marvel has transformed his career and personal life after an unlikely twist of fate over a decade ago saw him offered the role of Vision moments after being told his Hollywood career was over.
Speaking to Reuters at the London premiere of Disney+ TV miniseries "VisionQuest" on Monday, Bettany said being part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe had afforded him opportunities both on and off screen.
"It means I have been able to not take jobs and spend time with my family. It means that I've been able to direct and write a movie. It means that I can get movies that I wouldn't without it funded," he said.
Bettany first joined Marvel as the voice of artificial intelligence assistant J.A.R.V.I.S. before making his on-screen debut as android Vision in 2015's "Avengers: Age of Ultron."
The actor said the opportunity to play Vision came at a difficult point in his career, after a producer told him that two box office disappointments had effectively ended his prospects in Hollywood.
"I was doing an audition with a producer who will remain nameless, who told me my career was over," he said. "I got up, I walked out, I went downstairs and my legs gave way. I sat on Sunset Boulevard and I went, you know what, maybe he's right, maybe my career is over," Bettany said.
"Then my phone rang, I answered it and it was Joss Whedon who said, 'Would you like to play the Vision?' And that is a true story."
"VisionQuest" completes a trilogy that began with 2021's "WandaVision" and continued with 2024's "Agatha All Along". The new series follows Vision as he searches for a new purpose while on the run with a mysterious boy who may be his son.
Creator and showrunner Terry Matalas said the series engages with contemporary concerns around AI.
"We have this house that's supposed to be in the mind of an AI and it gets things slightly off in the way that AI does when it's taking an amalgamation of many things and turning it into one," he said.
For actor James D'Arcy, "VisionQuest" continues a hallmark of Marvel storytelling by combining action with emotional and philosophical themes.
"It's about the nature of being human," he said.

items.title: ＮＡＴＯ基金、対無人機と宇宙監視を重視　ポーランドに拠点
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Alicja Surdy　Marta Maciag

［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Alicja Surdy　Marta Maciag

［１３日　ロイター］ - 北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）が防衛技術向上に向けて創設したイノベーション基金（ＮＩＦ）のトップは、ロイターに対し、ロシアのウクライナ侵攻を受けてＮＡＴＯの防衛技術の優先順位が変わりつつあると述べ、対無人機（ドローン）システムや宇宙からの監視などの技術確保が急務と指摘した。

ＮＩＦはＮＡＴＯ加盟２４カ国が出資する１０億ユーロ（１１億２０００万ドル）規模のベンチャーキャピタル（ＶＣ）ファンド。ＮＡＴＯ東部地域で軍民両用（デュアルユース）技術の開発を加速させるため、ポーランドの首都ワルシャワに拠点を設け、投資先を探す。

アリ・ヨンソン総裁は、ウクライナでの戦争から得た教訓がＮＩＦの投資戦略に大きな影響を与えてきたと述べた。

「この地域では、ほかで見られないほどの規模で無人機の侵入が起きている」とし「実際に脅威を目の当たりにすると、意識が変わる」と語った。

ヨンソン氏によると、ＮＡＴＯ東部地域で喫緊の課題となっているのは、無人機を探知・追跡・無力化する技術と、宇宙を拠点とする情報収集・偵察能力だという。ポーランドは国防費が多く、新しい技術を積極的に受け入れ、エンジニアリングの基盤も強いため、投資先として魅力的だと話した。

次世代の防衛技術を求めて、あえて従来の防衛関連企業以外にも目を向けていると説明した。

On today's show, global stock losses deepened on renewed concerns about the AI trade. Korea's Kospi slid 7% after the Broadcom CEO Hock Tan compared AI investors to gamblers in a casino.

LVMH reported a 5% fall in sales in its biggest division, the fashion and leather goods unit, as worsening economic conditions and a consumer backlash in China hit its key Louis Vuitton brand.

And the Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi says the world is undergoing a "big transformation" where new technology has the power to create opportunities for millions of people. He was speaking in his keynote address at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 韓国、公務員1万人と中央政府44機関を世宗移転　31年までに
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[ソウル １３日 ロイター] - 韓国は２０２７年から３１年にかけて、約１万人の公務員と４４の中央政府機関をソウル首都圏から世宗市へ移転させる。行政安全省が１３日に発表した。

詳細は以下の通り。

• ２７年には、２９９５人の職員を擁する２７の機関が、世宗の賃貸オフィススペースを利用して移転。

• 早期に移転する機関には、金融委員会、個人情報保護委員会、原子力安全委員会、国家人権委員会、在外同胞庁が含まれる。

• 専用施設を必要とする１７の機関は、新しい政府庁舎が建設された後に移転し、３１年までに移転を完了する予定。

• これらには、外務省、統一省、国防省、警察庁、監査院、高位公職者犯罪捜査処、および新設される検察機関と重大犯罪捜査機関が含まれる。

• 政府は、新しいオフィス複合施設の建設に約３兆１０００億ウォン（２３億ドル）が必要になると見積もっており、賃貸施設や移転支援には８９７億ウォンが費やされる見込み。

•

items.title: Mike Elko regrets calling out 'cesspool' part of Texas A&M fanbase
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Two days after calling the team's leading fan website a "cesspool," Texas A&M coach Mike Elko walked back his comments on Monday and again accepted responsibility for the Aggies' 3-3 start to the season.
items.body:
Two days after calling the team's leading fan website a "cesspool," Texas A&M coach Mike Elko walked back his comments on Monday and again accepted responsibility for the Aggies' 3-3 start to the season.
Following Texas A&M's 27-6 loss on Saturday at then-No. 14 Missouri, Elko referenced TexAgs, a site co-owned by Billy Liucci.
Elko said at the time, "There's one group that I really don't care much about. Billy's cesspool can go be Billy's cesspool. Our fanbase: Stay with us, be behind us, we're going to build something that we told you we were going to build. We're in a really bad spot right now, but we'll work our way out of it."
At his Monday press conference, Elko said, "I think in the heat of the moment, I answered a question in a way I certainly regret. I think everybody knows I appreciate our fanbase and everything that they're about and everything they mean to Texas A&M. I regret the way it was taken, I regret the way it came out. I regret the way it ran. That certainly was never my intention.
"And certainly, throughout the course of that interview, at no point ever did I lend any blame to anything other than myself. I am the reason why this team is struggling. I have owned that since this has started. I continue to own that. It's my job to figure out how to get it better."
Elko added about Liucci, "I think everybody knows I have a tremendous relationship with Billy. I appreciate Billy. I appreciate him being here today."
Liucci told The Athletic following Elko's original comments, "It was just (the) wrong time and wrong audience to be saying that to, the way the season is going. ... I think Coach Elko understands that. He just had a moment where the frustration came out at the podium. That never goes well."
According to The Athletic, TexAgs is college sports' largest independent fan site in terms of paid subscribers.
Texas A&M was ranked No. 9 in the country entering its SEC opener against visiting Kentucky on Sept. 19. The Aggies dropped that contest 31-21, then were routed 35-6 on the road by then-No. 10 LSU the following week.
A 34-7 home rout of Arkansas was followed by the Missouri loss that dropped the Aggies' conference record to 1-3.
The latest setback prompted Elko to cede the defensive playcalling to defensive coordinator Lyle Hemphill.
"That was an important step just so I could have the freedom to be involved in everything," Elko said Monday. "I just think that was probably to the detriment of us for a couple weeks -- LSU, Kentucky -- (I was) trying to do too many things and probably not doing any of them well, to be honest."
--Field Level Media

items.title: EEUU se opone a la "coacción" china, tras las sanciones impuestas a los ministros de Belice y Paraguay
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Gobierno de Trump se opone a la "coacción y la agresión" de China contra países que ejercen sus derechos soberanos, dijo el Departamento de Estado de EEUU, después de que Pekín impusiera sanciones a ministros de Belice y Paraguay por sus vínculos con Taiwán.
items.body:
El Gobierno de Trump se opone a la "coacción y la agresión" de China contra países que ejercen sus derechos soberanos, dijo el Departamento de Estado de EEUU, después de que Pekín impusiera sanciones a ministros de [USN:L6N45Y0KJ TEXT:"Belice y Paraguay"] por sus vínculos con Taiwán.
Paraguay y Belice son dos de los apenas 12 países que mantienen relaciones diplomáticas formales con Taiwán. China afirma que Taiwán es una de sus provincias y que no tiene derecho a comportarse como un Estado, una opinión que el Gobierno de Taipéi rechaza rotundamente.
Las sanciones son en gran medida simbólicas, ya que los ministros de los aliados diplomáticos de Taiwán no suelen viajar a China. Pekín ya ha impuesto anteriormente medidas similares, principalmente a políticos occidentales, por su apoyo a Taiwán, un país gobernado democráticamente.
"El Gobierno de Trump se opone a la coacción y la agresión de China contra países de nuestro hemisferio por ejercer sus derechos soberanos", dijo el portavoz del Departamento de Estado, Tommy Pigott, en un comunicado.
Pigott citó comentarios anteriores del secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, según los cuales EEUU "no permitirá que nuestra región se convierta en una base de operaciones para que adversarios, competidores y rivales amenacen nuestra seguridad o socaven nuestras alianzas".
"Apoyamos a nuestros amigos y socios, incluido Taiwán, para promover nuestra prosperidad, seguridad y valores compartidos", añadió Pigott.
Estados Unidos es el principal valedor internacional de Taiwán, a pesar de la falta de relaciones diplomáticas formales.
A Washington le preocupan no solo los esfuerzos de Pekín por ganarse a los aliados que aún le quedan a Taiwán, sino también sus intentos por aumentar su influencia en América Latina.
LA VISIBILIDAD DE TAIWÁN "AUMENTA" En declaraciones a los periodistas el martes en el Parlamento de Taipéi, el viceministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Taiwán, Chen Ming-chi, dijo que China estaba extendiendo su "represión transnacional" a los aliados de Taiwán.
"La visibilidad internacional de Taiwán es cada vez mayor, y este hecho les mantendrá muy ocupados", afirmó Chen, refiriéndose a China. "¿Acaso pretenden sancionar al mundo entero?".
El primer ministro de Taiwán, Cho Jung-tai, dijo que Pekín no tiene derecho a interferir en los asuntos internos ni a influir en la diplomacia de ningún Estado soberano e independiente, "incluida la República de China", en referencia al nombre oficial de la isla.
"Al mismo tiempo, nos opondremos a cualquier expansión de la hegemonía o el autoritarismo", añadió, también en su intervención ante el Parlamento.
China ha intensificado la presión sobre los aliados diplomáticos que aún le quedan a Taiwán para que rompan relaciones con Taipéi.
El último país en hacerlo fue la pequeña nación insular del Pacífico de Nauru, en 2024. Honduras puso fin a sus relaciones con Taiwán, que se remontaban a varias décadas, en 2023.

items.title: South African rand edges up ahead of local mining data
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Tuesday as investors awaited domestic mining production data, while markets looked ahead to US inflation figures for fresh signals on the Federal Reserve's interest-rate trajectory.
items.body:
The South African rand edged up in early trade on Tuesday as investors awaited domestic mining production data, while markets looked ahead to US inflation figures for fresh signals on the Federal Reserve's interest-rate trajectory.
At 0630 GMT, the rand traded at 16.5150 against the dollar , about 0.2% firmer than its previous close.
Statistics South Africa is due to publish August mining production data (ZAMNG=ECI) at 0930 GMT, with economists expecting another contraction after output [USN:S8N43P0BS TEXT:"fell 7.5% year on year in July"].
"We expect mining production to remain in contraction, mainly reflecting elevated domestic input costs, softer commodity prices in some key segments and subdued global demand," Nedbank economists said in a note.
The dollar index was down, lending support to the rand, while [USN:L1N45Z00X TEXT:"oil prices fell"] as traders assessed supply risks following attacks on Saudi Arabia and weighed the prospect of additional diesel supplies from Russia.
Investors are also focused on Wednesday's US Consumer Price Index report, one of the last major data releases before the Federal Reserve's late-October policy meeting.
Like other risk-sensitive currencies, the rand often takes its cues from global factors, particularly US monetary policy, alongside domestic economic data.
South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was firmer in early deals, as the yield fell 3 basis points to 8.785%.
items.raw_description: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Tuesday as investors awaited domestic mining production data, while markets looked ahead to US inflation figures for fresh signals on the Federal Reserve's interest-rate trajectory.

items.title: Stellantis Q3 shipments fall 1%, weighed down by North America production halt
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Franco-Italian automaker Stellantis said on Tuesday its global third-quarter shipments fell 1% from a year ago to an estimated 1.3 million vehicles, hit by a summer production shutdown in North America.
items.body:
Franco-Italian automaker Stellantis (STLAM.MI) said on Tuesday its global third-quarter shipments fell 1% from a year ago to an estimated 1.3 million vehicles, hit by a summer production shutdown in North America.
Stellantis is launching six new vehicles and unveiling nine concept cars at the [USN:L6N45Y0D2 TEXT:"Paris Motor Show"] this week, after CEO Antonio Filosa announced a €60 billion ($67 billion) turnaround plan [USN:L8N41Y13N TEXT:"in May"], after two years of declining market share and weak sales.
In North America, vehicle shipments dropped 12% to 357,000 units, mainly due to the shutdown that affected Jeep models like the Grand Cherokee and Compass, each down by 25,000 units year-on-year
Europe shipments rose 10% to 588,000 units, the only region improving on a yearly basis, fuelled by demand for EV models
The European figure includes around 44,000 vehicles from Chinese partner Leapmotor (9863.HK) , which Stellantis distributes in the region
Shipments in the Middle East and Africa fell 21% to 75,000 due to lower volumes in Turkey and Gulf Cooperation Council countries, impacted by conflicts in the region
Stellantis is due to report its complete third-quarter results on October 28
($1 = 0.8945 euros)

items.title: Hitze und Trockenheit belasten deutsche Weinernte - Gute Qualität erwartet
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Deutschlands Winzer erwarten in diesem Jahr eine unterdurchschnittliche Weinernte. Die Erntemenge werde voraussichtlich bei 8,0 Millionen Hektoliter Weinmost liegen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag mitteilte. Das wären zwar fünf Prozent mehr als im schwachen Vorjahr, aber vier Prozent weniger als im längerfristigen Durchschnitt der Jahre 2020 bis 2025. "Das bisherige Weinjahr 2026 ist durch Trockenheit und Hitze gekennzeichnet", erklärte das Statistikamt. "Durch den Wassermangel bleiben die Traubenbeeren eher klein, was sich auf die zu erwartenden Erntemengen auswirkt."
items.body:
Deutschlands Winzer erwarten in diesem Jahr eine unterdurchschnittliche Weinernte. Die Erntemenge werde voraussichtlich bei 8,0 Millionen Hektoliter Weinmost liegen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag mitteilte. Das wären zwar fünf Prozent mehr als im schwachen Vorjahr, aber vier Prozent weniger als im längerfristigen Durchschnitt der Jahre 2020 bis 2025. "Das bisherige Weinjahr 2026 ist durch Trockenheit und Hitze gekennzeichnet", erklärte das Statistikamt. "Durch den Wassermangel bleiben die Traubenbeeren eher klein, was sich auf die zu erwartenden Erntemengen auswirkt."
Die gute Nachricht für Weintrinker: Der Wassermangel führt zu einer höheren Konzentration der Inhaltsstoffe in den Trauben. Das lasse voraussichtlich "einen qualitativ guten Weinjahrgang erwarten", so das Statistikamt. Großflächige Schäden seien, abgesehen von lokal begrenzten Hagelereignissen, bisher ausgeblieben.
Die Entwicklung fällt in den deutschen Anbaugebieten sehr unterschiedlich aus. In den drei größten Regionen Rheinhessen, Pfalz und Baden werden deutliche Zuwächse im Vergleich zum Vorjahr erwartet. Dies liegt allerdings auch daran, dass dort die Erntemengen 2025 besonders niedrig ausgefallen waren. Rückgänge werden hingegen unter anderem für die Mosel, Franken und die Ahr prognostiziert. Bei den Rebsorten dürfte vor allem der Riesling mit einem Plus von acht Prozent auf 1,8 Millionen Hektoliter zulegen. Für den Dornfelder wird sogar ein Zuwachs von neun Prozent erwartet. Dagegen wird bei den Sorten Grüner Silvaner und Blauer Portugieser mit einer geringeren Erntemenge gerechnet.
Insgesamt dürften der Schätzung zufolge 70 Prozent der Ernte auf Weißwein entfallen und 30 Prozent auf Rotwein. Die Zahlen beruhen auf einer Schätzung vom 20. September. Die Statistiker wiesen darauf hin, dass sich die erwarteten Mengen je nach Witterung und dem möglichen Auftreten von Schädlingen bis zum Abschluss der Lese noch ändern können.

items.title: イタリア、ＥＵ財政是正手続き脱却に暗雲　赤字拡大で中銀警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Giuseppe Fonte

[ローマ １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Giuseppe Fonte

[ローマ １２日 ロイター] - イタリア中央銀行は１２日、同国の２０２７年と２８年の財政赤字が国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３％を超える見通しとなったことで、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の過剰財政赤字是正手続き（ＥＤＰ）から脱却するのが難しくなる恐れがあると警告した。

是正手続きからの脱却は、ジョルジェッティ経済・財務相が長年追求してきた目標であり、イタリアの財政健全化努力の総仕上げと位置付けられる。

政府は今月、２６年の財政赤字は１９年以降で初めてＥＵが上限とするＧＤＰ比３％以内に収まるとの見通しを示した。ただ２７年以降については、ＥＵが加盟国に認める財政ルールの例外措置を活用し、防衛費を増やすほか、中東情勢の混乱を背景としたエネルギー危機への対応に財政支出を振り向けることから、財政赤字が再び拡大すると見込んだ。

中銀担当者は議員への説明で、ルールの枠組みに「非対称性」があるため、是正手続きから脱却する目標を達成できないリスクがあると警告。ＥＵの柔軟措置により、財政赤字がＧＤＰ比３％を超えてもＥＤＰの開始は回避されるが、「既にＥＤＰの対象となっている国が手続きから脱却しようとする際には、同様の規定はない」と述べた。

items.title: クマによる人身被害、ロシアでも急増　今春以降、少なくとも22人死亡　もはやクマに「同情できない」との声も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
ロシアのヒグマの生息数は、この30年間で2倍以上に増えた。冬が短く、暖かくなったことなどが背景にある。2026年はクマに襲われて死亡する事案が相次ぎ、外出を恐れる住民の姿が通りから消えた地域もある。政府はクマの生息数を抑える緊急対策を策定中だとしているが、一部の猟師は自ら行動を起こしている。

　◇

シベリアのクラスノヤルスク地方で、猟師によるヒグマ駆除が行われている。

この辺りではクマに襲われ、人が死亡する事案が相次いでいる。猟師のミハイル・コンダコフさんによると、近くのポドテソボ集落の住民から助けを求める声が寄せられている。

猟師　ミハイル・コンダコフさん
「クマが集落の中にまで入ってくることが増えた。2026年には悲劇が起きた。キノコ狩りに出かけた女性2人が、人食いグマに殺された。そこで私たち猟師は、住民の要望も受け、自主的にグループをつくった。集落の中にも周辺にもクマがあまりに多いため、クマ狩りを始めることにした」

　◇

シベリアのクラスノヤルスク地方で、猟師によるヒグマ駆除が行われている。

この辺りではクマに襲われ、人が死亡する事案が相次いでいる。猟師のミハイル・コンダコフさんによると、近くのポドテソボ集落の住民から助けを求める声が寄せられている。

猟師　ミハイル・コンダコフさん
「クマが集落の中にまで入ってくることが増えた。2026年には悲劇が起きた。キノコ狩りに出かけた女性2人が、人食いグマに殺された。そこで私たち猟師は、住民の要望も受け、自主的にグループをつくった。集落の中にも周辺にもクマがあまりに多いため、クマ狩りを始めることにした」

こうした問題はロシア各地で起きている。国営メディアによると、2026年春以降、少なくとも22人がクマに襲われて死亡した。ロシア政府は9月、ヒグマの生息数を抑える緊急対策を策定中だと発表した。

ヒグマの生息数は、この30年間で2倍以上の30万8000頭に増えた。冬が短く、暖かくなったことなどが背景にある。

ポドテソボのゾーヤ・グバノワさんは8月下旬、森に食べ物を採りに出かけた際にクマに襲われ、死亡した。

ポドテソボの住民　ユリア・マルコワさん
「犠牲者は、森がこれほど危険になったとは思っていなかったのだと思う。例えばゾーヤさんは、森に住んでいるも同然だった。春に山菜採りの季節が始まると、森の恵みで暮らしていた。森のことをよく知っていて、毎日通っていた」

そう話すユリア・マルコワさんは、クマへの同情心が薄れたという。「最初はクマがかわいそうだと思っていた。「森に食べ物が足りないのだろう。木の実が不作で、ベリーも少ないのだろう」と。でも猟師たちに言わせれば、実際はそれほど哀れな状態ではなく、痩せてもいない。それなら、なぜこれほど多くのクマが集落に来るようになったのか。こんな大量の出没は、これまで一度もなかった」

ロシアのメディアが伝えた専門家の見解によると、春の訪れが早く、乾燥していたため、餌となるベリーが不足し、クマはより遠くまで食べ物を探しに行かざるを得なくなった。

一方、人間の側にも、安全上の注意を守らず、クマを引き寄せる生ごみを屋外に放置しているとの批判がある。

クラスノヤルスク地方では、地方政府の環境当局が刑事事件の捜査対象となっている。同地方では、9月だけで7人がクマに襲われて死亡した。捜査当局は、環境当局がクマの生息数を適切に管理しなかったと指摘している。

一方ロシア環境省は、問題を小さく見せようとしている。同省によると近年、クマによる襲撃は20─30件程度が通常の水準だが、SNSやスマートフォンの普及によって、こうした襲撃がより広範囲で起きているように見えるという。

だが、ワレリア・エフレモワさんらポドテソボの住民の暮らしには、実際に影響が出ている。

ポドテソボの住民　ワレリア・エフレモワさん
「クマが森から出てくるようになってからは、公園に行くのも含め、外出をできる限り控えた。子どもたちが遊ぶ公園にもクマが来るので、本当に怖かった。暗くなってから外に出るなんて、とても考えられなかった。公園を散歩するのも、本当に久しぶりだと思う」

ウラジーミル・ワギンさんは、ラズベリーが育つ自宅の庭にも、もう出なくなった。夜はさらに外出が怖くなるという。

ポドテソボの住民　ウラジーミル・ワギンさん
「今、集落を車で回っているが、暗くて誰も外にいない。クマが集落に来るのを恐れて、人々は外出しない。いつ来てもおかしくないからだ。だから通りはこんなに閑散としている。人はおらず、車だけだ」

items.title: Teurer Sprit treibt Inflation erstmals seit 2023 über Drei-Prozent-Marke
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rekordpreise für Benzin und Diesel haben die Inflation in Deutschland im September auf den höchsten Stand seit fast drei Jahren getrieben. Waren und Dienstleistungen verteuerten sich um 3,3 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat, nach 2,9 Prozent im August, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag seine frühere Schätzung bestätigte. Einen höheren Wert gab es zuletzt im Dezember 2023. "Verantwortlich für den Anstieg der Inflationsrate war erneut die Entwicklung der Energiepreise", sagte die Präsidentin des Statistikamtes, Ruth Brand. "Besonders zeigte sich die Teuerung bei Mineralölprodukten an den Tankstellen und beim Heizöl."
items.body:
Rekordpreise für Benzin und Diesel haben die Inflation in Deutschland im September auf den höchsten Stand seit fast drei Jahren getrieben. Waren und Dienstleistungen verteuerten sich um 3,3 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat, nach 2,9 Prozent im August, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag seine frühere Schätzung bestätigte. Einen höheren Wert gab es zuletzt im Dezember 2023. "Verantwortlich für den Anstieg der Inflationsrate war erneut die Entwicklung der Energiepreise", sagte die Präsidentin des Statistikamtes, Ruth Brand. "Besonders zeigte sich die Teuerung bei Mineralölprodukten an den Tankstellen und beim Heizöl."
Kraftstoffe verteuerten sich im September um 37,1 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat, Heizöl sogar um 74,9 Prozent. Die Ölpreise waren durch den Krieg in Nahost zeitweise über die Marke von 100 Dollar je Barrel gestiegen. Deshalb mussten dem Autoklub ADAC zufolge im September mehrfach Rekordpreise für Diesel und Benzin an den Zapfsäulen bezahlt werden. Der teure Sprit hat die Bundesregierung aktiv werden lassen: Seit 1. Oktober bis zum Jahresende gilt ein neuer Tankrabatt - eine Subvention, die bereits im Mai und Juni zum Tragen kam. Das dürfte die Kraftstoffpreise um bis zu 17 Cent je Liter und damit die Inflationsrate um etwa 0,3 Prozentpunkte drücken, erwarten Ökonomen.
STROM GÜNSTIGER Energie insgesamt verteuerte sich im September um 14,9 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat, nach 10,5 Prozent im August. Das war das größte Plus seit Februar 2023. Strom (-5,5 Prozent), Erdgas (-2,8 Prozent) und Fernwärme (-1,0 Prozent) verbilligten sich dabei - was teilweise auf die bereits seit Jahresbeginn umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Bundesregierung zurückzuführen ist. So wurde etwa die Gasspeicherumlage abgeschafft.
Nahrungsmittel kosteten durchschnittlich 0,4 Prozent mehr (August: +0,1 Prozent). Deutlich teurer wurden Eier (+15,2 Prozent), frisches Gemüse (+12,0 Prozent) sowie Fisch, Fischwaren und Meeresfrüchte (+4,5 Prozent), während Butter (-29,5 Prozent), frisches Obst (-4,9 Prozent) und Molkereiprodukte (-5,5 Prozent) weniger kosteten.
Für Dienstleistungen wurden 2,7 Prozent mehr verlangt (August: +2,8 Prozent). Dienstleistungen sozialer Einrichtungen (+6,3 Prozent), die Wartung und Reparatur von Fahrzeugen (+4,7 Prozent) sowie Friseurbesuche und andere Dienstleistungen für die Körperpflege (+4,3 Prozent) kosteten merklich mehr, ebenso Pauschalreisen (+3,8 Prozent).
Die Preise ohne Nahrungsmittel und Energie, auch als Kerninflation bezeichnet, legten erneut um 2,4 Prozent zu. Von August auf September zogen die Verbraucherpreise insgesamt um 0,6 Prozent an. Da die Inflation auch in der Euro-Zone insgesamt steigen dürfte, rechnen Volkswirte mit weiteren Zinserhöhungen durch die Europäische Zentralbank (EZB). Diese hat ihren Leitzins in diesem Jahr bereits zweimal heraufgesetzt - auf aktuell 2,50 Prozent. Im Oktober dürften die Währungshüter aber noch abwarten. "Der Inflationsanstieg ist sichtbar, aber nicht breit angelegt", sagte der Leiter Volkswirtschaft der Fondsgesellschaft Union Investment, Michael Herzum. "Für die EZB ist die höhere deutsche Inflationsrate deshalb kein starkes Argument für eine unmittelbare Zinsanhebung." Viele Experten rechnen im Dezember mit dem nächsten Schritt.
items.raw_description: Rekordpreise für Benzin und Diesel haben die Inflation in Deutschland im September auf den höchsten Stand seit fast drei Jahren getrieben. Waren und Dienstleistungen verteuerten sich um 3,3 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat, nach 2,9 Prozent im August, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag seine frühere Schätzung bestätigte. Einen höheren Wert gab es zuletzt im Dezember 2023. "Verantwortlich für den Anstieg der Inflationsrate war erneut die Entwicklung der Energiepreise", sagte die Präsidentin des Statistikamtes, Ruth Brand. "Besonders zeigte sich die Teuerung bei Mineralölprodukten an den Tankstellen und beim Heizöl."

items.title: Premier Inn owner Whitbread backs turnaround plan, urges vote against Corvex seat
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Premier Inn owner Whitbread on Tuesday backed its five-year turnaround plan and recommended shareholders vote against activist investor Corvex Management's demand for a board seat.
items.body:
Premier Inn owner Whitbread (WTB.L) on Tuesday backed its five-year turnaround plan and recommended shareholders vote against activist investor Corvex Management's demand for a board seat.
Britain's largest hotel operator is defending a [USN:L6N41D0FX TEXT:"strategy "]that includes job cuts and the closure of branded restaurants, against Corvex, which last month [USN:L6N45E073 TEXT:"escalated "]its campaign by demanding a seat on the board.
The US-based hedge fund dropped its earlier push for an outright sale in September, saying it would join the board "with no preconceived notions and no predetermined agenda — only a commitment to maximizing risk-adjusted value for all shareholders".
In April, Whitbread CEO Dominic Paul unveiled plans to shut 197 remaining branded restaurants, sell £1.5 billion of freehold property and potentially cut about 3,800 jobs, as he pivots the group toward a higher-margin, pure-play hotel model.
British business rate hikes announced in last year's autumn budget saddled the UK's hospitality sector with higher costs, further exacerbated by a surge in energy prices triggered by the Iran war.
"With excellent strategic progress and strong current trading momentum, our plan is working," Paul said on Tuesday.
Whitbread beat first-half adjusted pre-tax profit expectations and backed its full year outlook, as strong hotel trading in the UK and Germany helped offset cost inflation and the disruption of exiting its branded restaurant business.
In the five weeks to October 1, the hotel operator's UK accommodation sales were up 4.5%, while sales in Germany climbed 31.2%.
The company said a general meeting to consider Corvex's resolution to add a new board member will be held on November 9.

items.title: China's exports seen growing at faster pace in September
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's exports are expected to have expanded at a slightly faster pace in September, sustaining robust momentum despite pressure from some trading partners and remaining an economic growth driver.
items.body:
China's exports are expected to have expanded at a slightly faster pace in September, sustaining robust momentum despite pressure from some trading partners and remaining an economic growth driver.
Economists polled by Reuters forecast that exports rose 25.5% year-on-year in US dollar terms, accelerating from the 25% growth in August. Import growth is expected to have slowed to 24.5% from 28.2% the previous month.
The trade surplus is expected to have dipped to $118.10 billion in September from $119.09 billion the previous month, according to the median forecast. China's customs administration will release trade data on Wednesday.
Another month of solid export performance would indicate the global AI boom kept demand robust for Chinese-made high-tech products and that manufacturers could keep relying on outbound shipments to absorb their production capacity in the face of lacklustre domestic demand.
Pressure from the US and the European Union for China to address its industrial overcapacity and surging trade surplus, which is on track to surpass $1 trillion for a second year, has yet to materially dent Beijing's overall export performance.
China and the US [USN:L1N45F0IM TEXT:"agreed"] to extend their trade truce and pursue [USN:L6N45K03P TEXT:"tariff cuts"] on $30 billion worth of goods for each side following a leaders' summit in Washington last month. An October [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"agreement"] to limit China's hybrid vehicle exports to the EU deals a [USN:L1N45Y05Y TEXT:"blow"] to China's car exports, though the hit is unlikely to be felt this year.
China's official manufacturing purchasing managers' index [USN:L4N45L06S TEXT:"rose"] to 50.1 in September from 49.8 the previous month, with the sub-indexes for new orders and production both in expansionary territory, indicating a recovery in business sentiment.
Steady manufacturing and export strength would also mean that policymakers could still bank on moderate policy support to meet China's 4.5% to 5% annual GDP growth target, even as weak domestic consumption and investment and a property market slump strain the economy.
The country's top leaders have signalled greater urgency to prop up domestic demand and infrastructure investment after the economy lost steam and the growth rate [USN:L1N43H01A TEXT:"slowed"] to a more-than-three-year low of 4.3% in the second quarter. But analysts say they do not expect large-scale stimulus measures unless the export pillar falters.
Third-quarter GDP data are due early next week.
